items.author: Marc Andreessen
items.title: On AI infrastructure investment thesis
items.content: The next wave of AI value creation is in the infrastructure layer: better training systems, inference optimization, and model serving at scale. We're seeing 10x efficiency gains year-over-year. This is where the durable moats are being built.

items.author: a16z
items.title: The AI Agent Economy: Why We Invested $50M in Agentic Platforms
items.content: AI agents that can act autonomously represent the next frontier. We're seeing early signs of an 'agent economy' where AI systems will transact with each other. Our thesis: the platforms enabling agent-to-agent interactions will capture massive value.
items.excerpt: Why we believe AI agents represent a $1T+ opportunity and our investment in platforms enabling autonomous AI-to-AI transactions...

items.author: Garry Tan
items.title: YC W24 AI batch insights
items.content: 40% of our current batch is AI-focused. Most interesting trend: vertical-specific AI tools (legal AI, medical AI) are seeing 10x faster adoption than horizontal tools. Domain expertise + AI = unfair advantage.

items.author: Sequoia Capital
items.title: Foundation Model Margins: The Unit Economics Reality
items.content: After analyzing 50+ AI companies, a pattern emerges: gross margins are stabilizing at 60-70% as inference costs drop. The winners will be those who build defensible distribution and create switching costs beyond the model itself.
items.excerpt: Deep dive into the unit economics of AI companies and why distribution beats technology in the long run...
